trans-unit.source:
Comma-separated list of directories to be monitored. Example: 1:/ (for fileadmin/)
Wildcards are supported: 1:/*/images/ 1:/**/images/
trans-unit.target:
Lista de diretórios separados por vírgulas a serem monitorados. Exemplo: 1:/ (para fileadmin/)
Curinga são suportadas: 1:/*/images/ 1:/**/images/

trans-unit.source: Images with a file size larger than this value will be resized (allowed units: B|K|M).
trans-unit.target: Imagens com um tamanho de arquivo maior do que este valor serão redimensionadas (unidades permitidas: B|K|M).

trans-unit.source: Images will be resized up to this maximum size. Example: 8M (for 8 megapixels).
trans-unit.target: As imagens serão redimensionadas até este tamanho máximo. Exemplo: 8M (para 8 megapixels).

trans-unit.source: Will try to auto-magically orient image (useful with photos).
trans-unit.target: Tentará auto-direcionar a imagem (útil com fotos).

trans-unit.source: If ticked, IM will not use $GLOBALS['TYPO3_CONF_VARS']['GFX']['im_stripProfileCommand'] and thus, color profile and metadata such as EXIF, IPTC and XMP will be kept.
trans-unit.target: Se marcado, o IM não usará $GLOBALS['TYPO3_CONF_VARS']['GFX']['im_stripProfileCommand'] e, assim, o perfil de cor e metadados como EXIF, IPTC e XMP serão mantidos.
Redimensionar arquivos PNG com canal alfa

trans-unit.source: If ticked, PNG files with an alpha channel will be resized even though the transparency will be lost.
trans-unit.target: Se marcado, arquivos PNG com um canal alfa serão redimensionados mesmo que a transparência seja perdida.

trans-unit.source: Line-separated list of conversion mapping instructions. This lets you automatically convert the type of the image while resizing it.
trans-unit.target: Lista separada por linha de instruções de mapeamento de conversão. Isso permite converter automaticamente o tipo da imagem ao redimensioná-la.

trans-unit.source: You may define as many rule sets as you wish. They will be evaluated one after the other in order to possibly override general settings. The evalutation stops as soon as a matching rule set has been found.
trans-unit.target: You may define as many rule sets as you wish. They will be evaluated one after the other in order to possibly override general settings. The evalutation stops as soon as a matching rule set has been found.
